title: Data Pipelines: Move and Transform Your Site's Data | Orchard Core
description:
Data often has to leave a site or enter it: a spreadsheet of content items, a nightly file for another system, a CSV file whose rows become content items. Done by hand, the work repeats every time.

The Orchard Core Data Pipelines module lets an administrator design a pipeline: sources read rows, transforms change them, files write them, and destinations deliver the result. This video builds a pipeline that reads Blog Post content items, writes them to a CSV file and saves the file to the media library, then runs it and reads its history.

In this video:
• Why Data Pipelines: sources, transforms, files and destinations
• Enable Data Pipelines and find its pages in the Tools menu
• Create a pipeline and open the designer
• Build a pipeline: a source, a file and a destination
• Publish the pipeline, run it and read the run history
• What else pipelines do: steps, schedules and permissions
